title: A Park for Everyone
text:
Tom lives in a busy city. There are many cars and very few green places. Last year, the people in his neighbourhood asked the city for a new park. After many meetings, the city agreed.

Now the park is open. Old people walk there in the morning, and children play on the grass after school. Tom says the park makes the neighbourhood feel friendly and safe.

questions.text: What did the people in Tom's neighbourhood ask the city for?
Who walks in the park in the morning?
Why was the park important for the neighbourhood?
options: It gave people a safe and friendly place

questions.text: What can we infer about the neighbourhood before the park was built?
options: It did not have enough places for people to relax

vocabulary.definition: an area of a town where people live
said yes to a plan or request
kind and easy to talk to

paragraph_translations: Том живе у великому місті. Тут багато машин і дуже мало зелених місць. Минулого року люди в його районі попросили місто побудувати новий парк. Після багатьох зустрічей місто погодилося.
Тепер парк відкритий. Вранці там гуляють літні люди, а після школи діти грають на траві. Том каже, що парк робить район дружнім і безпечним.
